ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture section (AL1) meets 9am-3:50pm (with lunch break) on Tuesdays AND 9am-Noon on Thursdays. All students must enroll in the lecture section (AL1) and a lab section (AB1, AB2 or AB4) to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and undergraduates (juniors or seniors) must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). See http://courseweb.lis.uiuc.edu/~mwolske/lis451/ for details regarding lab emphases and travel requirements when making a decision regarding selecting a lab section. A $70 non-waived course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition & fees bill.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
